name: Congresswoman Norma Torres Youth Advisory Committee
city: Chino, Chino Hills, Eastvale, Ontario, Montclair, Pomona, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga and Upland, CA
what_you_do: Go to six monthly sessions run by a congressional office. You learn about local fields like transportation, trade, education, health care and government. You also build leadership skills.
who_can_apply: You must be in high school and live in the 35th Congressional District. The list has nine cities: Chino, Chino Hills, Eastvale, Ontario, Montclair, Pomona, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga and Upland. Use the House website to check your address.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: End of January 2027 to June 2027, six monthly sessions
deadline_text: Apply by Dec 31, 2026. Spots fill as people apply, so do not wait.
how_to_apply: Fill out the 2027 online form linked on the program page.
notes: Questions: Matthew Trabert at the district office, 909-481-6474 or Matthew.Trabert@mail.house.gov.
